verdict.rationale: Speech is Cheap is a transcription API. Its own integration docs describe workflows that automatically transcribe audio from Google Drive into Google Sheets or a Zapier Table, and async jobs can report completion via webhooks. However, the automation runtime is Zapier or Google, not a native automation or scheduling feature of the product. Missing for 10: native first-party automation or trigger configuration, scheduling or watch-folder capability within the product itself, depth of the integration documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration that these automations run unattended.
